target.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to paragraph breaks in post md messages
target.body: ## What Problem This Solves When OpenClaw sends messages to Feishu via `msg_type: post` with `tag: md`, single newline characters (`\n`) are rendered as plain spaces by the Feishu IM API. This causes multi-paragraph prose to appear visually cramped. Fixes #97074 ## Why This Change Was Made Added `normalizeFeishuPostMarkdownNewlines()` — a dedicated function that upgrades single `\n` to `\n\n` outside code regions for Feishu post+md rendering. It runs only after the render mode is known, so card and document-comment text are never modified. **Revision 4** (per ClawSweeper review — all three findings addressed): 1. **[P1] Card routing on raw text** — `sendOutboundText` now routes `shouldUseCard(text)` on the original text before any normalization. Card text sent via `sendMarkdownCardFeishu` is never passed through the newline upgrader. Normalization happens only after the post-md path is confirmed. 2. **[P2] Post-md rechunk after expansion** — After normalization, if the expanded text exceeds 4000 characters, `sendOutboundText` rechunks it with `chunkTextForOutbound` and sends each chunk as a separate post message. A chunk that was within limit before expansion but grows past it is now handled correctly. 3. **[P2] Edit-path length guard** — `editMessageFeishu` now checks the normalized length against the 4000-character post limit before building the patch payload, throwing a clear error if it would exceed the Feishu API boundary. **Previous revision 3** (P1 chunker scope fix): Moved normalization **out of** `feishuOutbound.chunker`. The chunker runs before target-specific routing, so normalizing there rewrites text for card and document-comment paths too. The normalizer now runs only at post-md-scoped entry points. **Previous revision** (P1 chunk/limit ordering): Normalization runs before chunk/limit decisions so the chunker measures expanded length. ## User Impact - Post-md messages render with visible paragraph breaks instead of cramped single-spaced text - Card-mode and document-comment text is never modified (single newlines preserved) - Post-md sends rechunk after expansion so every payload stays inside Feishu's 4000-char limit - Edit path rejects over-limit expanded content with a clear error instead of failing silently at the API ## Evidence - `pnpm test extensions/feishu/src/send.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts` — 161/161 passed - `node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.json --quiet extensions/feishu/src/outbound.ts extensions/feishu/src/send.ts` — clean - `pnpm format:check` — All matched files use the correct format - `pnpm build` — exit 0 ### Real behavior proof Behavior addressed: card routing on raw text, post-md rechunk after expansion, edit-path length guard. Real environment tested: Linux (Node 24.13.1), branch `fix/97074-feishu-post-md-newline`, commit `c8c567659b`. Exact steps run: 1. Unit test suite (161 tests): card path receives raw text, post-md path normalizes + rechunks, edit path guards expanded length 2. Previous revision: Gateway started (`pnpm openclaw gateway --port 18789 run`) — feishu WebSocket connected, bot open_id resolved. Direct Feishu API comparison — `msg_type: post` + `tag: md` with single `\n` vs `\n\n` **Screenshots**: comparison of single-`\n` vs double-`\n` post-md messages in Feishu client What was not tested: bot reply via gateway (Feishu error 230101 blocked DM replies), older Feishu client versions, live rechunk path (near-limit expanded post), live edit-path limit rejection.
